CheckTitle: Ensure Unused Custom Roles Are Disabled or Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion pod with Basic Auth (Connections page): SCIM Roles or HCM REST roles, and userAccounts with userAccountRoles
Description: Custom roles not assigned to anyone should be inactivated, or their assignment and use monitored.
Risk: An unused role can be assigned quietly and used for unintended actions.
AuditProcedure: Identify custom roles with no user assignments in the Security Console.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Example: control 80001.

Steps: Inactivate the role, or keep it and monitor its use.
Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.

Notes: Automated: custom roles (code not starting with ORA_, duty roles left out) with no user assignment fail. Whether role use is monitored in Risk Management (control 80001) is for the assessor to confirm.
